notes: v583 — FAILURES NAME THEMSELVES, AND RETRY ANSWERS INSTANTLY. When signal grading failed, the radar could only ever say ‘could not reach our server’ — whether the true cause was a timeout, a rate limit, a network drop or a genuine server fault — and pressing ‘try again’ gave no visible response until the background work finished, so it felt like a dead button. Now: the failure line states the actual reason (e.g. ‘the request ran past its time limit — the first grade of a new day is the slow one; a retry usually returns instantly’, or ‘the server said: too many grade requests this hour — resets within the hour’), and pressing try again (or a floor button) flips the strip to ⏳ immediately, before any network happens. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
